home.sub: Water, wastewater, soil, sludge and marine testing, from on-site sampling to signed laboratory reports. Based in Riyadh, serving the entire Kingdom.
home.servicesTitle: Every sample, every matrix, one trusted lab
home.servicesSub: Six core testing lines backed by our own in-house laboratory and field team.
home.journeySub: From the moment our engineer fills the bottle to the moment you receive a signed report, every step is controlled and documented.

journey.d: Our engineer collects a representative sample with the right container and preservative.
Each sample is labelled, GPS-tagged and logged on a custody form.
Samples are checked for temperature and integrity, then registered with a unique ID.
Our chemists and microbiologists run validated methods on calibrated instruments.
Blanks, duplicates and reference standards are checked before results are released.
You receive a signed PDF report that compares results against the applicable limits.

about.title: The laboratory arm of AECON
about.sub: BSA.lab (Biological System Analysis) was set up so that AECON's clients could get consultancy, field sampling and laboratory analysis under one roof.
about.story1: For years, AECON has helped developers, industries and government entities across Saudi Arabia understand and manage their environmental impact, through EIAs, air quality monitoring, marine studies, soil investigation and remediation.
about.story2: Every one of those projects depends on reliable laboratory data. BSA.lab brings that capability in-house: a dedicated environmental laboratory and field sampling team, focused on water, wastewater, soil, sludge and marine testing.
about.mission: To give every client fast, accurate and defensible environmental data that helps them protect people, comply with Saudi regulations and make better decisions.
about.vision: To be the most trusted environmental laboratory in the Kingdom, known for precision, integrity and service.

values.d: Validated methods, calibrated instruments and rigorous QA/QC.
Impartial results, reported exactly as measured.
Data that helps protect the Kingdom's water, soil and seas.
Clear communication and turnaround you can plan around.

about.vision2030: Vision 2030, the Saudi Green Initiative and the national push to reuse treated wastewater all depend on measurement. BSA.lab supports operators, developers and regulators with the data they need to meet these goals.
about.aeconText: AECON is a Riyadh-based environmental and geotechnical consultancy delivering EIAs, air quality monitoring, marine and coastal studies, soil investigation, hydrogeology and site remediation across Saudi Arabia.
quality: Documented QA/QC on every analytical batch

sampling.title: Our engineers come to your site
sampling.sub: Correct sampling is half of an accurate result. Our field team collects, preserves and delivers your samples under full chain of custody, anywhere in Saudi Arabia.

steps.d: We agree the sampling points, parameters and schedule with you, and prepare the right bottles and preservatives.
Our engineer arrives with calibrated meters, cool boxes, PPE and a sampling kit for your site.
Unstable parameters such as pH, temperature, DO and chlorine are measured at the sampling point.
Representative grab or composite samples are taken, preserved and labelled.
GPS coordinates, photos and field sheets are recorded, and the chain-of-custody form is signed.
Samples travel chilled to our Riyadh laboratory within their holding time.

sampling.mapSub: Based in Riyadh and mobilising to every region.

lab.title: Inside the BSA.lab laboratory
lab.sub: A dedicated environmental laboratory in Riyadh working to ISO/IEC 17025, with ICP-MS, spectrophotometry, titration, GC and microbiology sections. SAC accreditation is in progress.

sections.d: Temperature and integrity checks, registration and secure cold storage.
BOD, COD, solids, alkalinity, hardness, nutrients and anions.
Metals and organic contaminants on spectroscopic and chromatographic instruments.
Coliforms, E. coli, HPC, Legionella and pathogens in a dedicated clean area.

lab.samplingText: Our field team performs standard sampling of groundwater, wastewater, sewage and soil. pH, electrical conductivity, temperature, salinity and dissolved oxygen are measured immediately on site, following EPA recommendations.
